subject: Life Skills
title: The 50/30/20 Rule
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The 50/30/20 Rule.

hook.text: Senator Elizabeth Warren proposed a budgeting rule so simple it fits on a napkin. It works for most income levels.

buildup.text: 50% of after-tax income goes to needs: rent, food, utilities, insurance. These are bills you cannot skip.

discovery.text: 30% goes to wants: dining out, hobbies, streaming, vacations. Wants are not waste — they are what makes life enjoyable.

twist.text: If your needs exceed 50%, the answer is not cutting wants to 0%.

climax.text: 20% goes to savings and debt repayment. Automate this transfer on payday. Money you never see is money you never spend.

punchline.text: 50 needs, 30 wants, 20 future. One rule, one napkin.

quiz.question: What should the 20% in the 50/30/20 rule cover?
